item.title: 1974 EMS SYNTHI 100 Up For Sale
item.description: via this Reverb listing "Up for sale is an original 1974 EMS Synthi 100 Synthesizer. I am the second owner of this amazing instrument. It is in incredible condition for an item of its age and size.
